title: Stiff Neck
synopsis: Have you ever gotten a stiff neck from sleeping on it wrong?

fullText.simplified:
落枕了

    “哎呦，等会儿，我脖子动不了了。”很多人一觉醒来都经历过这样的事情，那就是脖子歪向一边不能动了或者一转头脖子就会很疼。
    这种情况我们叫它“落枕”。这是一种常见病，青壮年是易发人群，冬春季多见。落枕常常是睡前没有任何症状，早上起床后却发现颈部活动受限，有明显的疼痛感。
    引起落枕的原因主要有两个：一是夜间睡眠姿势不良，头颈长时间处于过度偏转的位置；二是因为枕头不合适，过高、过低或过硬等。除了上边提到的两个原因，还有一个老百姓们常说的原因是身体受寒了。具体来说就是晚上睡觉时没盖好被子，导致寒气进入了身体里，而脖子后边是最容易受寒的部位。
    如果真的落枕了，应该怎么办呢？
    一般来说，落枕是不需要治疗的，两三天以后可以自愈。但是落枕让人非常不舒服，不仅疼痛，还影响工作和生活。毕竟一直歪着脖子或者脖子不能动是件很麻烦的事情。
    如果不小心落枕了，想快速恢复，你可以试试下边这几个方法：
    热敷脖子后边三十分钟左右。这么做可以加速血液循环，消除身体的寒气。
    除了热敷，也可以适当进行颈部锻炼。如后仰、前伸、左右拉伸等，这些动作都应该缓慢进行，不能用力过猛。
    其实，对于年轻人来说，预防大于治疗。拒做“低头族”是防止落枕的关键。地铁里、公交车上、甚至是路上，随处可见低头看手机的人。工作的时候，常常对着电脑一坐就是一天，这对脖子和腰的损害都非常大。久而久之，人们的颈椎就会因为过度疲劳出现问题，落枕就是早期颈椎有问题的警示信号。
    现在的生活和工作压力是很大，但是必要的运动和放松绝不能少。毕竟身体是革命的本钱呀！
fullText.traditional:
落枕了

    “哎呦，等會兒，我脖子動不了了。”很多人一覺醒來都經歷過這樣的事情，那就是脖子歪向一邊不能動了或者一轉頭脖子就會很疼。
    這種情況我們叫它“落枕”。這是一種常見病，青壯年是易發人群，冬春季多見。落枕常常是睡前沒有任何症狀，早上起床後卻發現頸部活動受限，有明顯的疼痛感。
    引起落枕的原因主要有兩個：一是夜間睡眠姿勢不良，頭頸長時間處於過度偏轉的位置；二是因為枕頭不合適，過高、過低或過硬等。除了上邊提到的兩個原因，還有一個老百姓們常說的原因是身體受寒了。具體來說就是晚上睡覺時沒蓋好被子，導致寒氣進入了身體裡，而脖子後邊是最容易受寒的部位。
    如果真的落枕了，應該怎麼辦呢？
    一般來說，落枕是不需要治療的，兩三天以後可以自愈。但是落枕讓人非常不舒服，不僅疼痛，還影響工作和生活。畢竟一直歪著脖子或者脖子不能動是件很麻煩的事情。
    如果不小心落枕了，想快速恢復，你可以試試下邊這幾個方法：
    熱敷脖子後邊三十分鐘左右。這麼做可以加速血液循環，消除身體的寒氣。
    除了熱敷，也可以適當進行頸部鍛鍊。如後仰、前伸、左右拉伸等，這些動作都應該緩慢進行，不能用力過猛。
    其實，對於年輕人來說，預防大於治療。拒做“低頭族”是防止落枕的關鍵。地鐵裡、公交車上、甚至是路上，隨處可見低頭看手機的人。工作的時候，常常對著電腦一坐就是一天，這對脖子和腰的損害都非常大。久而久之，人們的頸椎就會因為過度疲勞出現問題，落枕就是早期頸椎有問題的警示信號。
    現在的生活和工作壓力是很大，但是必要的運動和放鬆絕不能少。畢竟身體是革命的本錢呀！

sentences.english: “Ouch! Hold on, I can’t move my neck.” Many people experience this when they wake up.
Their necks will be crooked to one side and unable to move or will hurt a lot when they try to turn their heads.

sentences.simplified: 这种情况我们叫它“落枕”。
sentences.traditional: 這種情況我們叫它“落枕”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng wǒ men jiào tā lào zhěn

sentences.traditional: 這是一種常見病，青壯年是易發人群，冬春季多見。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì yì zhǒng cháng jiàn bìng qīng zhuàng nián shì yì fā rén qún dōng chūn jì duō jiàn
sentences.english: We call this situation “stiff neck”.

sentences.simplified: 落枕常常是睡前没有任何症状，早上起床后却发现颈部活动受限，有明显的疼痛感。
sentences.traditional: 落枕常常是睡前沒有任何症狀，早上起床後卻發現頸部活動受限，有明顯的疼痛感。
sentences.pinyin: lào zhěn cháng cháng shì shuì qián méi yǒu rèn hé zhèng zhuàng zǎo shang qǐ chuáng hòu què fā xiàn jǐng bù huó dòng shòu xiàn yǒu míng xiǎn de téng tòng gǎn
sentences.english: This is a common condition, most often occurring among young adults, and it is very common in winter and spring.
It is common in stiff neck to go to bed without any symptoms but wake up finding limited movement and significant pain in the neck.

sentences.traditional: 引起落枕的原因主要有兩個：
sentences.pinyin: yǐn qǐ lào zhěn de yuán yīn zhǔ yào yǒu liǎng ge

sentences.simplified: 一是夜间睡眠姿势不良，头颈长时间处于过度偏转的位置；
sentences.traditional: 一是夜間睡眠姿勢不良，頭頸長時間處於過度偏轉的位置；
sentences.pinyin: yī shì yè jiān shuì mián zī shì bù liáng tóu jǐng cháng shí jiān chǔ yú guò dù piān zhuǎn de wèi zhi
sentences.english: There are two main causes of a stiff neck:

sentences.simplified: 二是因为枕头不合适，过高、过低或过硬等。
sentences.traditional: 二是因為枕頭不合適，過高、過低或過硬等。
sentences.pinyin: èr shì yīn wèi zhěn tou bù hé shì guò gāo guò dī huò guò yìng děng
sentences.english: The first is poor sleeping posture at night, with the head and neck in an excessively deflected position for a long period of time.

sentences.simplified: 除了上边提到的两个原因，
sentences.traditional: 除了上邊提到的兩個原因，
sentences.pinyin: chú le shang biān tí dào de liǎng ge yuán yīn
sentences.english: The second is because the pillow is not suitable. It might be too high, too low, too hard, and so on.

sentences.simplified: 还有一个老百姓们常说的原因是身体受寒了。
sentences.traditional: 還有一個老百姓們常說的原因是身體受寒了。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yí ge lǎo bǎi xìng men cháng shuō de yuán yīn shì shēn tǐ shòu hán le
sentences.english: In addition to the two reasons mentioned above, ..

sentences.simplified: 具体来说就是晚上睡觉时没盖好被子，导致寒气进入了身体里，
sentences.traditional: 具體來說就是晚上睡覺時沒蓋好被子，導致寒氣進入了身體裡，
sentences.pinyin: jù tǐ lái shuō jiù shì wǎn shang shuì jiào shí méi gài hǎo bèi zi dǎo zhì hán qì jìn rù le shēn tǐ lǐ
sentences.english: .. there is another reason that people often mention, which is that the body is affected by cold.

sentences.simplified: 而脖子后边是最容易受寒的部位。
sentences.traditional: 而脖子後邊是最容易受寒的部位。
sentences.pinyin: ér bó zi hòu bian shì zuì róng yì shòu hán de bù wèi
sentences.english: Specifically, this means sleeping at night without covering yourself with a blanket, causing cold air to enter the body.
The back of the neck is the most susceptible to the cold.

sentences.simplified: 如果真的落枕了，应该怎么办呢？
sentences.traditional: 如果真的落枕了，應該怎麼辦呢？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zhēn de lào zhěn le yīng gāi zěn me bàn ne

sentences.english: If you really get a stiff neck, what should you do?

sentences.simplified: 一般来说，落枕是不需要治疗的，两三天以后可以自愈。
sentences.traditional: 一般來說，落枕是不需要治療的，兩三天以後可以自愈。
sentences.pinyin: yì bān lái shuō lào zhěn shì bù xū yào zhì liáo de liǎng sān tiān yǐ hòu kě yǐ zì yù

sentences.simplified: 但是落枕让人非常不舒服，不仅疼痛，还影响工作和生活。
sentences.traditional: 但是落枕讓人非常不舒服，不僅疼痛，還影響工作和生活。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì lào zhěn ràng rén fēi cháng bù shū fu bù jǐn téng tòng hái yǐng xiǎng gōng zuò hé shēng huó
sentences.english: Normally speaking, a stiff neck does not need to be treated. It will heal itself in two or three days.

sentences.simplified: 毕竟一直歪着脖子或者脖子不能动是件很麻烦的事情。
sentences.traditional: 畢竟一直歪著脖子或者脖子不能動是件很麻煩的事情。
sentences.pinyin: bì jìng yì zhí wāi zhe bó zi huò zhě bó zi bù néng dòng shì jiàn hěn má fan de shì qing
sentences.english: However, a stiff neck causes a lot of discomfort. As well as being painful, it also affects work and life.
After all, it is very inconvenient to constantly have a crooked or immobile neck.

sentences.simplified: 如果不小心落枕了，想快速恢复，你可以试试下边这几个方法：
sentences.traditional: 如果不小心落枕了，想快速恢復，你可以試試下邊這幾個方法：
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ bù xiǎo xīn lào zhěn le xiǎng kuài sù huī fù nǐ kě yǐ shì shì xià bian zhè jǐ ge fāng fǎ

sentences.english: If you accidentally get a stiff neck and want to recover quickly, you can try the following methods:

sentences.simplified: 热敷脖子后边三十分钟左右。
sentences.traditional: 熱敷脖子後邊三十分鐘左右。
sentences.pinyin: rè fū bó zi hòu bian sān shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu

sentences.simplified: 这么做可以加速血液循环，消除身体的寒气。
sentences.traditional: 這麼做可以加速血液循環，消除身體的寒氣。
sentences.pinyin: zhè me zuò kě yǐ jiā sù xuè yè xún huán xiāo chú shēn tǐ de hán qì
sentences.english: Apply heat to the back of the neck for around 30 minutes.
Doing so can improve blood circulation and get rid of the coldness in the body.

sentences.simplified: 除了热敷，也可以适当进行颈部锻炼。
sentences.traditional: 除了熱敷，也可以適當進行頸部鍛鍊。
sentences.pinyin: chú le rè fū yě kě yǐ shì dàng jìn xíng jǐng bù duàn liàn

sentences.simplified: 如后仰、前伸、左右拉伸等，
sentences.traditional: 如後仰、前伸、左右拉伸等，
sentences.pinyin: rú hòu yǎng qián shēn zuǒ yòu lā shēn děng
sentences.english: Aside from applying heat, you can also try some appropriate neck exercises.

sentences.simplified: 这些动作都应该缓慢进行，不能用力过猛。
sentences.traditional: 這些動作都應該緩慢進行，不能用力過猛。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē dòng zuò dōu yīng gāi huǎn màn jìn xíng bù néng yòng lì guò měng
sentences.english: For example, extending backward, stretching forward, stretching left and right, and so on.
These exercises should be done slowly and not too aggressively.

sentences.simplified: 其实，对于年轻人来说，预防大于治疗。
sentences.traditional: 其實，對於年輕人來說，預防大於治療。
sentences.pinyin: qí shí duì yú nián qīng rén lái shuō yù fáng dà yú zhì liáo

sentences.simplified: 拒做“低头族”是防止落枕的关键。
sentences.traditional: 拒做“低頭族”是防止落枕的關鍵。
sentences.pinyin: jù zuò dī tóu zú shì fáng zhǐ lào zhěn de guān jiàn
sentences.english: Actually, for young people, prevention is better than cure.

sentences.simplified: 地铁里、公交车上、甚至是路上，随处可见低头看手机的人。
sentences.traditional: 地鐵裡、公交車上、甚至是路上，隨處可見低頭看手機的人。
sentences.pinyin: dì tiě lǐ gōng jiāo chē shang shèn zhì shì lù shang suí chù kě jiàn dī tóu kàn shǒu jī de rén
sentences.english: Refusing to be a “smartphone zombie” is key to preventing a stiff neck.

sentences.simplified: 工作的时候，常常对着电脑一坐就是一天，
sentences.traditional: 工作的時候，常常對著電腦一坐就是一天，
sentences.pinyin: gōng zuò de shí hou cháng cháng duì zhe diàn nǎo yí zuò jiù shì yì tiān
sentences.english: In the subway, on the bus, and even on the street, people who have their heads down looking at their phones are everywhere.

sentences.simplified: 这对脖子和腰的损害都非常大。
sentences.traditional: 這對脖子和腰的損害都非常大。
sentences.pinyin: zhè duì bó zi hé yāo de sǔn hài dōu fēi cháng dà
sentences.english: At work, it’s very common to sit in front of the computer for the entire day.

sentences.simplified: 久而久之，人们的颈椎就会因为过度疲劳出现问题，
sentences.traditional: 久而久之，人們的頸椎就會因為過度疲勞出現問題，
sentences.pinyin: jiǔ ér jiǔ zhī rén men de jǐng zhuī jiù huì yīn wèi guò dù pí láo chū xiàn wèn tí
sentences.english: This is very damaging to both the neck and the lower back.

sentences.simplified: 落枕就是早期颈椎有问题的警示信号。
sentences.traditional: 落枕就是早期頸椎有問題的警示信號。
sentences.pinyin: lào zhěn jiù shì zǎo qī jǐng zhuī yǒu wèn tí de jǐng shì xìn hào
sentences.english: Over time, people’s cervical spines will develop problems due to overuse.
A stiff neck is a warning sign for the start of cervical spine problems.

sentences.simplified: 现在的生活和工作压力是很大，但是必要的运动和放松绝不能少。
sentences.traditional: 現在的生活和工作壓力是很大，但是必要的運動和放鬆絕不能少。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài de shēng huó hé gōng zuò yā lì shì hěn dà dàn shì bì yào de yùn dòng hé fàng sōng jué bù néng shǎo

sentences.simplified: 毕竟身体是革命的本钱呀！
sentences.traditional: 畢竟身體是革命的本錢呀！
sentences.pinyin: bì jìng shēn tǐ shì gé mìng de běn qián ya
sentences.english: Nowadays, life and work are very stressful, but we need to get enough exercise and relaxation.

sentence_translations: Stiff Neck
“Ouch! Hold on, I can’t move my neck.” Many people experience this when they wake up.
Their necks will be crooked to one side and unable to move or will hurt a lot when they try to turn their heads.
We call this situation “stiff neck”.
This is a common condition, most often occurring among young adults, and it is very common in winter and spring.
It is common in stiff neck to go to bed without any symptoms but wake up finding limited movement and significant pain in the neck.
There are two main causes of a stiff neck:
The first is poor sleeping posture at night, with the head and neck in an excessively deflected position for a long period of time.
The second is because the pillow is not suitable. It might be too high, too low, too hard, and so on.
In addition to the two reasons mentioned above, ..
.. there is another reason that people often mention, which is that the body is affected by cold.
Specifically, this means sleeping at night without covering yourself with a blanket, causing cold air to enter the body.
The back of the neck is the most susceptible to the cold.
If you really get a stiff neck, what should you do?
Normally speaking, a stiff neck does not need to be treated. It will heal itself in two or three days.
However, a stiff neck causes a lot of discomfort. As well as being painful, it also affects work and life.
After all, it is very inconvenient to constantly have a crooked or immobile neck.
If you accidentally get a stiff neck and want to recover quickly, you can try the following methods:
Apply heat to the back of the neck for around 30 minutes.
Doing so can improve blood circulation and get rid of the coldness in the body.
Aside from applying heat, you can also try some appropriate neck exercises.
For example, extending backward, stretching forward, stretching left and right, and so on.
These exercises should be done slowly and not too aggressively.
Actually, for young people, prevention is better than cure.
Refusing to be a “smartphone zombie” is key to preventing a stiff neck.
In the subway, on the bus, and even on the street, people who have their heads down looking at their phones are everywhere.
At work, it’s very common to sit in front of the computer for the entire day.
This is very damaging to both the neck and the lower back.
Over time, people’s cervical spines will develop problems due to overuse.
A stiff neck is a warning sign for the start of cervical spine problems.
Nowadays, life and work are very stressful, but we need to get enough exercise and relaxation.
After all, good health is a prerequisite for work!
